_comment: Castalia-Penta WOUND (CP4a): the TAPE-OUT product configuration -- config/wound.json's peripheral set VERBATIM (QSPI/I3C/NFC/RTC/PWM/OneWire/DMA/I2CTarget/TRNG/EVFAB, cqAfeStubs dropped, fieldPower/PGOOD live, castalia-lqfp100 package) -- PLUS config/penta.json's fifth hart (numHarts=5, managementHart=4: hart 4 is the always-on soft `orch_tile` orchestrator in the centre band, wired hart-0-style for power/reset and tile-style for boot/IRQ). This is the config the MCU_castalia physical lineage is built from, so it is the one the penta genus/P&R chain (genus/MCU_WOUND_PENTA, innovus/common/MCU_castalia_penta) consumes. KNOB INTERACTION NOTE: wound sets peripherals.cqAfeStubs=false, so the AFE/EIS stub bank does not exist here -- afe_stub's MGMT_HART privilege (CP1 D4) has no instance to apply to, and the `shorch` catalog row (which needs the cqAfeStubs tag) is NOT selected. The orchestrator's wound-config coverage is therefore the generic shared-fabric suite at N=5, not an orchestrator-specific test. numHarts=5 + dma=true means nMasters = 5 harts + DMA = 6 (MW=3). Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/penta_wound.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/penta_wound.json
